case.initial_fields: Bx=1; By=0.01*cos(2*pi*x/L); Bz=0.01*sin(2*pi*x/L), sampled at PHARE's proper field centre; ion u=0
case.name: P1_dt_half_same_physical_case

gates.G0_data: all 5 files, 11 identical times, correct source and configuration, float64, finite arrays, 64 owned cells, 25600 macro particles each time
gates.G1_perturbation: initial first-harmonic circular field complex amplitude within 2% of prescribed 0.01; enforce correct centring and both field components
gates.G2_number: max relative weighted-number drift <= max(1e-12,8*eps_float64*25600), and initial count-equivalent within 1e-10 of 6.4
gates.G3_Bx: max absolute Bx deviation from 1 <= 1e-12 and periodic endpoint mismatch <= 1e-12; strictly 1D
gates.G4_momentum: max Euclidean global ion momentum drift <= 0.05 * 0.064 = 0.0032 in normalised units
gates.G5_energy: max absolute change in ion kinetic plus magnetic energy <= 0.05 * 0.00032 = 0.000016, with direct per-component deltas, not fractional of 3.2 background
gates.G6_exchange: describe measured magnetic/ion kinetic exchange and field response; exploratory only; no acceptance threshold
gates.G7_continuity_work: exploratory and NOT TESTED, internal averaged fields unavailable

purpose: Prospective ONE-case controlled time-step sensitivity comparison against frozen raw Phase 3B.1D v0.4 reference
scientific_restrictions: two dt values at one grid/seed are a sensitivity check, not a convergence-order estimate
pre-registered thresholds are engineering screens, not a numerical theorem
no solar wind obstacle, geoeffectiveness or shielding claims
scope: single-level periodic 1D proton hybrid; Te=0, eta=0, hypereta=0; no AMR or obstacle

sensitivity_screens.S0_identical_initial_arrays: all 7 initial logical HDF5 datasets Bx/By/Bz and ion weight/iCell/delta/v must exactly match baseline SHA256, else INCONCLUSIVE_INITIAL_STATE
sensitivity_screens.S1_first_harmonic: max across same 11 physical times of complex first transverse mode difference / initial delta(0.01) <= 0.01 (absolute complex-mode bound 0.0001)
sensitivity_screens.S2_exchange: max across times of |DeltaKfine-DeltaKbase|/SE <= 0.02 AND |DeltaUBtransFine-DeltaUBtransBase|/SE <= 0.02, SE=0.00032 (absolute 6.4e-6)
sensitivity_screens.S3_momentum: max Euclidean difference between initial-subtracted total-ion momentum trajectories / SP <= 0.01, SP=0.064 (absolute 0.00064)
sensitivity_screens.S4_preserve_single_case_gates: fine run must separately satisfy original 1D G1-G5 screening thresholds, not just S1-S3
sensitivity_screens.S5_trend_exploratory: report max energy/momentum drift ratio fine/base but do not require monotone improvement from two dt values or claim convergence order

source_basis: Phase 3B.1D successful unperturbed diagnostic run 44774581522 and pinned source inspection
